title: Control which users can install agents and apps (Integrated apps)
problem: Users install third-party agents and Teams apps that access org data.
steps: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated apps: review deployed apps and agents, the Requested apps tab, and who each app is available to.
Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps: allow or block apps and agents per app and assign them to users/groups (app centric management). Org-wide app settings blocks all third-party apps.
Microsoft Entra admin center > Entra ID > Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions: restrict user consent and turn on the admin consent workflow so users can request apps.
pitfalls: Blocking all apps without an approval process drives shadow IT.
Teams app permission policies are deprecated; tenants were migrated to app centric management from April 2025, so old guidance about permission policies no longer applies.
